summary: Raeena Lari co-championed a Gaza ceasefire resolution at the Santa Clara County Board of Education, passed January 2024, acknowledging suffering of Palestinian and Israeli children while affirming an anti-Semitism and Islamophobia stance. CAIR Action endorsed her in the general election; she also holds owner-confirmed membership in the pro-Palestine Muslim community. BAMC Action supported her, its comment noting only her long trusteeship. The resolution's dual framing of child suffering is a minor note; co-sponsoring an early ceasefire resolution is the substantive record.
